name: p0_exemplars
selection_procedure: One exemplar per (qtype, answer_type) cell of MultiTQ train (exactly 8 cells exist: equal/entity, equal/time, before_after/entity, first_last/entity, first_last/time, equal_multi/entity, after_first/entity, before_last/entity), = the train question with the smallest quid in the cell. Only the qtype and answer_type fields of train were read to form the cells (metadata used to stratify exemplar selection, as dev metadata stratifies dev_sel2000); the question text of exactly these 8 was read.
parse_procedure: Parses written by hand from the question text and the KG vocabularies (entity2id.json, relation2id.json names) only, before any answer was consulted; conventions follow the compact P schema of the rule and the structural parser's label conventions (answer_role = object iff the main / first-mentioned entity is the subject of the relation; granularity = answer granularity for time answers, else the granularity of the time expression, day if none; order = before/after for before_after, after_first and before_last entity questions, first/last for first_last and equal_multi). The 8 gold answers may be consulted afterwards to verify the parses (supervision_disclosure); verification result is recorded in p0_exemplar_verification.json, not here.
serialisation: json.dumps(parse, ensure_ascii=False), key order mentions, relation, answer_role, qtype, answer_type, granularity, time, anchor, order
